tasks.subject: Task 1: DTO & Wire Mapper for IsPushed
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Capture the `is_pushed` proto field (Green stage wire member 16) end-to-end into `CommonPlayResultData.StageData` so downstream handlers can read it.

**Files:**
- Modify: `Application/Dtos/CommonPlayResultData.Green.cs`
- Modify: `Adapters.GameProtocol.Green/Mappers/PlayResultMappers.cs`
- Test: `Tests/Green/GreenPlayResultMapperTests.cs`

**Verify:** `dotnet test Tests/Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~GreenPlayResultMapperTests"`

**Steps:** see `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-15-green-song-category-fields/01-dto-and-wire-mapper.md`.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Application/Dtos/CommonPlayResultData.Green.cs", "Adapters.GameProtocol.Green/Mappers/PlayResultMappers.cs", "Tests/Green/GreenPlayResultMapperTests.cs"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet test Tests/Tests.csproj --filter \"FullyQualifiedName~GreenPlayResultMapperTests\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["CommonPlayResultData.StageData has Green-only IsPushed bool", "PlayResultMappers.MapStage copies stage.IsPushed", "Test Map_GreenPlayResult_PreservesIsPushed passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: GreenProfileCounters Helper
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure static helper that increments the matching `Categ*Cnt` for `music_categ` 0..7 and bumps `Song(Pushed|Favorite|Recent)Cnt` per stage. Saturates at `uint.MaxValue`.

**Verify:** `dotnet test Tests/Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~GreenProfileCountersTests"`

**Steps:** see `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-15-green-song-category-fields/03-profile-counters-helper.md`.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Application/Common/GreenProfileCounters.cs", "Tests/Green/GreenProfileCountersTests.cs"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet test Tests/Tests.csproj --filter \"FullyQualifiedName~GreenProfileCountersTests\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Genre 0..7 increments correct counter", "Out-of-range no-op", "Song flag counters increment", "uint.MaxValue saturates"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Save-Handler Integration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Wire the new counters and `IsPushed` into the Green playresult save path: reject stages with `music_categ > 7`, invoke `GreenProfileCounters.ApplyStage` per stage, and persist `IsPushed` on the play log row.

**Verify:** `dotnet test Tests/Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~GreenPlayResultHandlerTests"`

**Steps:** see `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-15-green-song-category-fields/04-save-handler-integration.md`.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Application/Handlers/UpdatePlayResultCommand.Green.cs", "Tests/Green/GreenPlayResultHandlerTests.cs"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet test Tests/Tests.csproj --filter \"FullyQualifiedName~GreenPlayResultHandlerTests\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["IsValidGreenStage rejects MusicCateg > 7", "Counters increment per stage", "IsPushed persisted on play log"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Recent-List Ordering & Favorites Cap
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make `GreenRecentSongs` server-tracked (upsert on every played stage, trim to 10 newest) and enforce the Green-era 5-favorite cap on the playresult write path.

**Verify:** `dotnet test Tests/Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~GreenPlayResultHandlerTests"`

**Steps:** see `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-15-green-song-category-fields/05-recent-list-and-favorites-cap.md`.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Application/Handlers/UpdatePlayResultCommand.Green.cs", "Tests/Green/GreenPlayResultHandlerTests.cs"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet test Tests/Tests.csproj --filter \"FullyQualifiedName~GreenPlayResultHandlerTests\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["UpsertFavoriteAndRecentAsync takes playTime param", "Recents upsert every stage", "Recents trim to 10", "Favorites cap at 5", "Favorites remove works at cap"]}
```
